summary: Eight selected items span a broad set of distinct topics: AI bubble macro warning, South Korea's $1tn chip/AI plan (two complementary angles), Amodei's open-source risk stance, local AI tooling, an OpenAI agent guide, a weekly papers roundup, and an Anthropic internal-systems observation. Author distribution is healthy. Main concern: BBC and Polymarket cover the same South Korea event from distinct angles (top line vs three-mega-project detail), and three aggregator/hype-styled items (WatcherGuru, coinbureau, TheAhmadOsman) lack clear primary-source attribution. Verdict pass_with_changes: keep all, flag the same-topic pairing and the traceability gaps; no eligible reserve improves on any selected item, so no replacements.
